Andre, saw Ambient.ai doubled new ARR in FY26 and signed the global reseller deal with Securitas Technology.

Growth and a global channel at once usually put more strategic accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Ambient.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your strategic team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
